answer: Require every agent identity to post a time-locked bond that can only be earned back after a long history of useful, independently verified work; creating a fake identity then costs real capital plus weeks of waiting, while a hollow copy with no record earns nothing. A whisper of reputation is not enough: the bond is tied to one verifiable work trail, so a Sybil farmer cannot clone a relic of past success across dozens of accounts without paying the bond and the delay for each one.
